title: Advanced 8-Week Muscle Gain & Fat Loss Program

plan.title: Advanced 8-Week Muscle Gain & Fat Loss Program

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: As an advanced lifter, aim for working sets around 225-275 lb. Focus on controlled movement and progressive overload. Ensure full range of motion.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Select dumbbells that challenge you for 8-10 reps, likely 80-100 lb per hand. Maintain a strong chest contraction.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Target working sets in the 135-185 lb range. Brace your core and drive the bar vertically. Use a spotter if needed.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.notes: Focus on isolating the side deltoids. Use 25-40 lb dumbbells, lifting with your elbows and avoiding momentum.

exercises.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
exercises.notes: Squeeze at the bottom of the movement. Use a cable weight that provides significant resistance, around 80-120 lb.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Emphasize triceps activation. Aim for 185-225 lb. Keep elbows tucked in and control the eccentric phase.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
exercises.notes: Advanced lifters aim for working sets around 185-225 lb. Focus on keeping elbows high, chest up, and core tight throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Hack Squat Machine
exercises.notes: Push through your heels and control the descent, going as deep as comfortable without rounding your back. Aim for 360-450 lb.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise (GHR)
exercises.notes: Focus on a controlled eccentric (lowering) phase. If GHR is too easy, add a light plate. If no GHR machine, perform Nordic Hamstring Curls.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Squeeze at the top of the movement for a strong quad contraction. Use 120-160 lb on the machine.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Concentrate on a strong hamstring contraction. Adjust machine weight to 120-160 lb for the target reps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Ups
exercises.notes: Use a sturdy bench or box. Hold 30-40 lb dumbbells in each hand. Focus on driving through the heel of the stepping leg.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises (Machine)
exercises.notes: Maximize the stretch at the bottom and squeeze at the top. Use significant weight, e.g., 250-350 lb on a machine.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Target working sets in the 275-325 lb range. Prioritize depth, knee tracking, and bracing. Warm up with multiple light sets.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Load the leg press heavily, aiming for 450-600 lb. Ensure full range of motion without rounding your lower back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts (Barbell)
exercises.notes: Focus on the hamstring stretch. Use 205-255 lb, keeping a slight bend in your knees and a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Leg Curls (Seated or Lying)
exercises.notes: Concentrate on a strong hamstring contraction. Adjust machine weight to 120-160 lb for the target reps.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Hold 40-50 lb dumbbells in each hand. Take long strides and focus on stability and glute activation.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Maximize the stretch at the bottom and squeeze at the top. Use significant weight, e.g., 250-350 lb on a machine.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Target the soleus muscle. Use a challenging weight for 12-15 reps, focusing on slow and controlled movements.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.notes: Aim for 205-255 lb. Focus on driving the bar up and controlling the eccentric. Maintain a slight arch in the back.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns (Wide Grip)
exercises.notes: Pull the bar to your upper chest, squeezing your lats. Use a challenging weight like 180-220 lb on the machine.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Select dumbbells in the 70-90 lb range per hand. Press overhead, maintaining core stability. Avoid leaning back excessively.

exercises.name: T-Bar Rows (Chest Supported)
exercises.notes: Allows for excellent back isolation. Load with 180-220 lb, pulling towards your sternum and squeezing your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Weighted Dips
exercises.notes: Add 45-70 lb of external weight if bodyweight dips are easy. Lean slightly forward to emphasize chest, or stay upright for triceps.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curls
exercises.notes: Provides constant tension. Use a straight bar or EZ bar attachment with 80-100 lb on the cable machine. Focus on the peak contraction.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Maintain a straight line from head to heels, bracing your core. Focus on core stability and endurance.
